# Osaka sales trip

Three members of the sales team will visit two customers in Osaka. General Affairs has booked the trains and the hotel.

## Schedule

| Date | Plan | Place |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Monday, 9 November 2026 | Shinkansen from Tokyo | Shin-Osaka |
| Tuesday, 10 November 2026 | Visit Kitahama Trading | Chuo-ku |
| Wednesday, 11 November 2026 | Tour the Sakai plant | Sakai |
| Thursday, 12 November 2026 | Meet Nanko Logistics | Suminoe-ku |
| Friday, 13 November 2026 | Return to Tokyo | Tokyo |

## How the visits run

On the first evening we meet in the hotel meeting room and read through the proposal and the quote together once more. On the second morning we see the purchasing manager of Kitahama Trading and walk through our terms for next year.

At the Sakai plant, a production engineer will show us the new inspection line. Take photos only where the guide says you may.

## Expected costs

- Shinkansen: $600
- Hotel: $960
- Local transport: $100
- Total: $1,660

## Reminders

- Arrive ten minutes before each meeting.
- Send your receipts to Accounting within a week of coming back.
- If a plan changes, tell Ms Tanaka in General Affairs straight away.
